how_to_read: decision is PAY, HOLD or EXCL (run vocabulary). Only items with schedule_now true (decision PAY) are scheduled. A HOLD item is scheduled only after its release_condition is met and the reconciler sends a new line with dec=PAY.
amount_to_pay is what the item pays when released, in the item's own currency: invoice gross for PAY and HOLD items, 0.00 for EXCL items.
variance_net is invoice net minus PO net, in the PO currency, positive when the invoice is above the PO. null where no PO comparison applies.
principal_approval_needed is true where the policy reserves the item for the principal and no approval has been given yet. approval uses the run vocabulary (REQ, OK, NO, NA).
amount_status OPEN means the amount is not final: only a PAY line with no OPEN amount is final. principal_answers records what the principal has answered on the item.
records lists the inbox records in work/invoices.json (R01 to R12) that belong to the item; the documents array gives the disposition of every record.
